svg.title: AxoSim and baseline comparison (light theme)
svg.desc: GRU Medium and Mamba Medium, three released Branch-ELM sizes, two released TCNs, and CoreNEURON; axes show inference throughput, dataset-relative voltage and subthreshold fidelity and Mean F1 0–5 ms, and history throughput. Axis mappings and measurements are documented in the technical report appendix.
